sourceUv.coordinates: U left-right; V top-bottom as recorded by Designer for the chest safe zone.

surfaceMapping.basis: GLB has one fabric mesh (defaultMaterial, mesh 0) with one TEXCOORD_0 atlas. Apply one complete base-color texture to that mesh; cream trim colors are baked from world-space triangle masks into the existing UV atlas. No mesh split or geometry edits.

spatialTrimMasks.coordinateSpace: world meters from Designer's preserved transforms
spatialTrimMasks.method: Classify each source triangle by its world-space centroid, then paint that same triangle's existing UV polygon.

placement.coordinateSpace: Full UV atlas as a single SVG texture input to studio-surface
placement.orientation: Atlas laid across the complete source UV domain; motif orientation is already baked into the atlas.

artworkPlacement.coordinateSpace: Existing TEXCOORD_0 UV atlas; V origin top-left per Designer's placement note.
artworkPlacement.orientation: Upright, not mirrored; tree trunk vertical.
artworkPlacement.surfaceExtent: Artwork restricted to front chest safe zone; red knit simulation covers the remaining atlas; cream spatial trims follow the source neck, cuffs and hem.
artworkPlacement.uvPolicy: Preserve TEXCOORD_0 and all geometry buffers byte-for-byte.
